enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body. Remain still. Breathe regularly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and taking a hot shower
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply face wash. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, then rinsing dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, milk. Close refrigerator. Open bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Toaster pops. Remove toast. Butter toast. Eat toast. Drink tea. Pick up plate. Scrape food into trash. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Turn off tap. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag and laptop
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt, pants, socks, underwear. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk to desk. Pick up laptop. Pick up charger. Place laptop in bag. Place charger in bag. Pick up notebook. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Place keys in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter office building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs at the nonprofit office, meeting partner organizations, and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check appointments. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Greet partner organizations. Shake hands. Sit down. Discuss program details. Take notes. Stand up. Walk back to desk. Make phone calls. Write emails. Organize files. Print documents. Answer phone calls. Update schedule. Send invitations. Review budget. Coordinate with volunteers.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk out of office. Walk to nearby restaurant. Enter restaurant. Order food. Pay cashier. Wait for food. Receive food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Dispose of trash. Walk back to office. Enter office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on program schedules, budgets, and volunteer coordination at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Calculate budget. Make phone calls to volunteers. Send emails. Organize schedule. Print documents. Review program plans. Update files. Meet with team. Take notes. Adjust budget. Coordinate volunteer shifts. Send reminders. Answer emails. Attend meeting. Write reports. File documents. Update calendar. Prepare materials.

Pack bag. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Ride bus. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place induction cooker on counter. Plug in. Turn on. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Cover pan. Wait. Turn off cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Put down drink. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower scheduled after 8pm to avoid the water-heater peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a game on the game console to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Select game. Start game. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Resume game. Play game. Turn off game console. Put down controller.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and planning tomorrow's program tasks by the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit at desk. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Pick up planner. Open planner. Write tasks. Close planner. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp.

Close book. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Remain still. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side.
